title: Dedicated autoscaling correctness dashboards + alerts (bounds violations, oscillation, scaling lag) + SLO panels
author: Allison Grant
description: Context: ENG-2846 adds structured autoscaling decision metrics/events in the redwood monorepo (desired_replicas/applied_replicas, clamp_reason, scaling actuation lag, oscillation counters, etc). This PR wires those signals into the standard observability-pack so SRE + Dedicated customers (via internal console dashboards) can quickly answer: (1) are we violating hard bounds? (should be 0), (2) are we oscillating? (cooldown tuning), and (3) are we scaling fast enough to meet latency SLOs (scale lag + queue/latency impact). Changes: Adds a new Grafana dashboard: "Dedicated / Autoscaling Correctness" with panels for Bound violations (min/max clamp events + any out-of-range applied replicas), Desired vs Applied replicas, Scale lag (p50/p95) split by region/hardware_class, Clamp reason breakdown (cardinality-safe), and Oscillation rate (replica delta sign flips / hour). Adds a new Grafana dashboard: "Dedicated / Autoscaling SLO" with error budget + burn-rate panels aligned with the SLO doc (scaling correctness and customer-visible impact). Adds PrometheusRule alerts: (1) DedicatedAutoscalingBoundViolation (page) when any applied_replicas > max_bound or < min_bound (should never happen; treat as bug or telemetry mismatch), (2) DedicatedAutoscalingScaleLagHigh (ticket) when p95 scale lag exceeds threshold for sustained period (indicates actuation stuck or fleet shortage), (3) DedicatedAutoscalingOscillationHigh (ticket) when oscillation rate indicates thrash (cooldown mis-tuned, unstable signal blend), (4) DedicatedAutoscalingClampToMaxSustained (ticket) when we are clamped at max for long enough to likely impact customer latency (used to drive comms / guidance; not a page). Notes: All alerts include routing labels (service=dedicated-autoscaler, team=sre-fleet) and link to runbook section "Dedicated autoscaling anomalies". To avoid metric cardinality issues, dashboards/alerts only group by {region, hardware_class, pool_tier} and explicitly avoid {pool_id}. For pool-level drilldown we rely on scaling decision events in the control plane (Console "Scaling History"), not metrics. Validation: Tested against staging Prometheus with a replayed dataset from autoscaler-oscillation-analysis. Confirmed panels populate with the new metric names emitted by redwood PR 21912 and clamp_reason label values emitted by PR 21905. Follow-ups: Once forecast confidence metrics ship (ENG-2844/2845), we should add a small panel showing confidence gating rate vs time to correlate with scale lag; not included here to keep this aligned to ENG-2846 scope.

conversation: Rafael Mendes: Bound violation alert should be paging, but make sure we don't page on telemetry gaps. Are you using absent() anywhere? Allison Grant: Good call. For bound violations I added a guard: only evaluate when autoscaler decision stream is present (autoscaler_decision_events_total > 0 over 10m) and we have applied_replicas samples. Also added a separate warning annotation for "no data" but not paging. Thomas Baird: Please remove pool_id from any group_by. This is going to explode cardinality (we have thousands of pools). Allison Grant: Updated. All queries group by region/hardware_class/pool_tier only. The dashboard now includes a note pointing to Console Scaling History for per-pool drilldown. Aisha Bello: For ScaleLagHigh, can we align threshold with the SLO doc? I think we said p95 > 6m for 30m is ticket-worthy; paging only on correctness violations. Allison Grant: Done. ScaleLagHigh is now severity=ticket (no page). Threshold: p95 > 6m for 30m, and a burn-rate panel in the SLO dashboard uses the same windowing. Sean Gallagher: Please add runbook links and ownership labels to all alerts so paging isn't ambiguous. Allison Grant: Added runbook_url annotations and standardized labels (team=sre-fleet, service=dedicated-autoscaler) across all new rules. Also added a short section in grafana/README.md on "Dedicated autoscaling correctness" dashboards + how to interpret clamp-to-max sustained. Rafael Mendes: One more ask: oscillation alert should ignore small fluctuations during maintenance/drains. Can we gate on scale actions > N? Allison Grant: Added a gate: require autoscaler_scale_actions_total > 10 over 30m in the same grouping. This filters out drain windows with 1-2 changes. Approvals: Aisha Bello approved. Thomas Baird approved after group_by fixes. Rafael Mendes approved with the gating updates. Sean Gallagher approved after runbook/labels added.
release_notes: Observability: New Dedicated autoscaling correctness dashboards and Prometheus alerts for bound violations (page), scaling lag (ticket), oscillation (ticket), and sustained clamping to max (ticket), plus an SLO overview dashboard aligned with ENG-2846 metrics.
